subject: nist-zero-draft-comment

metrics.draft_topic: NIST AI Risk Management Framework: GenAI Profile (Zero Draft)
comment_themes: Signed measurement as evidence primitive — every axis score should carry Ed25519 signature + Merkle inclusion proof
Anchored proof of when measurement was known — OpenTimestamps/Rekor as mandatory in high-risk profiles
Corrections ledger as structural requirement — published retraction history is the honesty primitive
Cross-organisational measurement verification — anyone can verify any signed card
Independence statement — measurement body must disclose all funding sources
Three-state verdicts (MEASURED / UNMEASURED / PENDING) instead of binary
metrics.owner_action: Final review before submission. Comment is free, public, can be filed by anyone.
metrics.delivery: Wednesday Sep 16, same day as Arc genesis measurement

honest_sentence: NIST Zero Draft (GenAI Profile) closes Sep 16 (3 days). Comment themes ready: signed evidence primitive, anchored proof of when known, corrections ledger requirement, three-state verdicts, independence disclosure. Owner review needed before submission.
